hypotheses.F0_terminal_source_factorial_recomposes: Every final-state and finite-output Shapley decomposition recomposes to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.F1_carried_state_is_material_for_transfe: Carried-state projection share is at least 0.30 in every cell of spelling, sentiment, gender, and tense.
hypotheses.F2_spelling_uses_more_fresh_attention: Spelling's mean combined-attention projection share exceeds every other transferable family's mean by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.F3_spelling_nonboundary_attention_is_exc: Spelling's mean nonboundary-attention share is at least twice the median of sentiment, gender, and tense.
hypotheses.F4_final_MLP_is_not_the_shared_semantic_: The absolute mean final-MLP projection share is below 0.20 for every transferable family.
hypotheses.F5_attention_share_predicts_shorter_head: Across all six families, mean combined-attention share correlates at most -0.5 with mean joint-head k90.
